title: Catalog pointer (latest.json)
description: Tiny pointer served from GitHub Pages. Clients fetch it conditionally (ETag) on every check. It must stay under 1 KiB and never lists datasets or skills.

latest_version.description: Pointer contract version. A client that does not know the value must treat the catalog as incompatible.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository whose raw files hold the data at `commit`.

commit.description: Full commit SHA the manifest and every file it lists were generated from.

cohort_id.description: sha256 over the sorted (id, data sha256, schema sha256) triples. Unchanged by commits that touch no catalog data, so clients can skip the manifest when it matches.

min_cli.description: Oldest Nosey version able to interpret this cohort (semver).

rule_language.description: Integer version of the detection-rule language (signal types and logic values) used by this cohort.

bytes.description: Exact size of manifest.json; clients reject a response that differs. Hard cap 64 KiB.
